regression_rule: a node regresses only when this manifest records it passed and the graded run reports it not-passed; absent at base cannot regress and a skip is neutral
reproduce: image is a config digest, never a local tag: a tag in the authoring host's daemon is unresolvable elsewhere, so a drifting baseline becomes phantom regressions with no symptom. Rebuild from base_image plus build_args and compare digests; platform matters because several excluded nodes are platform guards
